scope: Ki Blast Super catalog — additional DLC/Future Saga entries

records.name: Steel Mirage
records.effect: Rushes behind the opponent and throws a Destructo-Disc.

records.name: Divine Spear
records.character_source: Goku Black (Super Saiyan Rosé) Ultra Supervillain
records.effect: Fires a penetrating Ki wave; at close range it is unblockable and causes heavy stagger.

records.name: Dark Inscription
records.effect: Creates time rifts that launch sharp Ki projectiles; additional inputs spend more Ki and build Power of Time.

records.name: Burning Blast
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 180 - Battle of Resolve: VS Goku Black
records.effect: Releases an aura burst followed by a Ki Blast; the optional Stamina expenditure allows use while taking damage and can set up an Ultimate.

records.name: Force Edge
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 180 - Battle of Resolve: VS Goku Black
records.effect: Sends out a shockwave-like energy slash with a kick and can follow up on an immediate hit.

records.name: Demon Ray
records.effect: Fires a quick Ki blast with an optional follow-up Ki wave; 300 Stamina can allow activation while being hit.
